title: vicia tenuifolia subsp. elegans
intro: Vicia tenuifolia subsp. elegans, commonly known as slender vetch, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Vicia tenuifolia subsp. elegans include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve lipid profiles, and have antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
